title: Google Public Data Center Locations
scope: Coordinate-bearing public Google data-center location units identified from Google's location directory and official announcements. Ellis County, Texas is excluded as an aggregate alias of Midlothian and Red Oak. Cloud regions, zones, network edge points and undisclosed parcels are outside scope.
